lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity local maxima are arranged in a multi-row horizontal lattice posterior to the gill slits, extending along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical pixel clusters of moderate intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like topology across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal ridge feature demonstrates a high-contrast luminance step-function between the dorsal and lateral flank sections, exhibiting a sharp light-to-shadow gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency distribution of small, high-luminance pixel clusters is observed on the visible surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger, sparse blobs on the main flank.
